_comment: From: 'Monitoring and Observability on Azure with Azure Monitor and Application Insights'. Import into Azure Monitor Workbooks or adapt the KQL panels for Grafana's Azure Monitor data source.

panels.title: Request rate + error rate
panels.query: requests | summarize total=count(), failed=countif(success==false) by bin(timestamp, 1m)

panels.title: P50 / P95 / P99 latency
panels.query: requests | summarize p50=percentile(duration,50), p95=percentile(duration,95), p99=percentile(duration,99) by bin(timestamp, 1m)

panels.title: Dependency health
panels.query: dependencies | summarize avgDuration=avg(duration), failureRate=countif(success==false)*100.0/count() by target, bin(timestamp, 5m)
